name: session-begin-refuses-a-read-set-that-is-not-a-list-400
description: A malformed /session/begin is an HTTP 400 with a bare `{error}` -- the boundary shape gate, not the `{ok: false, reason}` envelope the route uses for a typed refusal. A client must branch on the status code for this class and on `reason` for the other.

body.error: read_set must be a list of repo-relative path strings
